Resolution criteria: This question will resolve as 'Yes' if both of the following conditions are met: (1) A Japanese company is ranked among the top 10 companies globally in terms of genetic research and development expenditure by a reputable source, such as EvaluatePharma or a major financial analytics firm, at any point between October 1, 2024, and January 1, 2028. (2) Taiwan's average annual temperature, as reported by the Central Weather Bureau of Taiwan, increases by at least 1.5 degrees Celsius above the 1991-2020 average at any point between October 1, 2024, and January 1, 2028.
